site_name: Railway Arch, 192 Bancroft Road, London, E1 4ET
reference_no_of_permission_being_relied_: This application for Listed Building Consent is to support the planning application ref. PP-14554121, relating to works which are proposed to be undertaken at railway arch 192 Bancroft Road.
description: Proposed alterations to the front elevation to include new metal door, replacement of existing metal shutter with new metal shutter, new metal door to the rear elevation and new masonry brick work infill. Brick repairs and minor repairs and cleaning to rear yard entrance. Internal works to include full strip out construction of accessible WC pod. Replacement concrete slab, smoothing/levelling and epoxy resin coating. Installation of arch lining system and new perimeter drainage. Installation of new LED lighting.ÿ
